message:
The users API test now passes. `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 failures.

The migration `migrations/001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` was reading and writing `full_name`. That mismatch caused the "unknown column users.full_name" error. I changed `src/api/users.js` to use `fullname`. I left the migration alone, since the DBA team owns it and it's already applied in production.
